title: Journey Home:
headline: One question for every elected official: what will you commit to doing about homelessness, and when?
story: A voice-only video. Dwayne wants every elected official in the county to answer one question: what will you commit to doing about homelessness, and when?
He is building an army of neighbors to ask it, write the answer down, and follow up together. It is a call to act, not a complaint. Strong, clear, hopeful.
